title: Comment
description: A comment, reply or suggested edit on a Markdown record, stored as its own record. The comment's Markdown body is its text.

document.description: Link to the commented record, such as [[chapters/method]]. Replies repeat their thread's document so one query finds a record's whole discussion.

in_reply_to.description: Link to the first comment of the thread this comment replies to. Absent on the first comment of a thread.

motivation.description: commenting starts a thread, replying answers one, and editing suggests replacing the target's text.

target.description: Where in the document the thread is anchored. Absent means the whole record. Only the first comment of a thread has a target.

quote.description: The anchored text and the text around it. The quote is authoritative; positions are a hint.

exact.description: The anchored text exactly as it appears in the record body. Empty for an insertion point, which prefix or suffix then locates.

prefix.description: Text immediately before exact, to tell repeated occurrences apart.

suffix.description: Text immediately after exact, to tell repeated occurrences apart.

text_position.description: Offsets of the quote in one revision of the record body.

profile.description: Offsets count the record's Markdown body as stored, after the frontmatter, so frontmatter edits never move them.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 body the offsets were measured in.

suggestion.description: The suggested edit of an editing comment: replace the target's quote with replacement.

replacement.description: The text to put in place of the quote. Empty suggests deleting it.

outcome.description: What happened to the suggestion once its thread was resolved.

status.description: Whether the thread is still open. Only meaningful on the first comment of a thread.

resolved_by.description: Link to the mdbase.person record of who resolved the thread.

created_by.description: Link to the mdbase.person record of the comment's author. Absent when the author has no person record.

deleted_at.description: When the comment was withdrawn. The record stays so its thread and replies keep their shape; its body should be emptied.
